name: Itsumi Yuria
source:
The protagonist's younger sister.
She was involved in a traffic accident with her parents and older brother, but miraculously survived.

Though she deeply grieves the death of her parents, she is a brave girl who is trying her best to live life with a positive attitude.

She is completely unaware of her brother's abnormal nature and brutal acts.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/soleil/itsudatsu/]official site[/url]]
